# unifi_setting_super_smtp (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_super_smtp` resource manages the custom SMTP server used by a UniFi console to send email notifications. The server attributes only apply when `enabled` is `true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_super_smtp" "example" {
  # Whether the custom SMTP server is enabled.
  enabled = true

  # The SMTP server attributes below are only applicable when enabled = true.
  host = "smtp.example.com"
  port = 587

  # Use a custom sender (From) address for outgoing messages.
  use_sender = true
  sender     = "noreply@example.com"

  # Use SSL/TLS when connecting to the SMTP server.
  use_ssl = true

  # Authenticate to the SMTP server. The credentials are sensitive -
  # prefer supplying them via variables.
  use_auth = true
  username = "smtp-user"
  # x_password = var.smtp_password

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to site configured in provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the custom SMTP server is enabled.

### Optional

- `host` (String) The SMTP server hostname or IP address. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `port` (Number) The SMTP server port. Valid values are 1-65535. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `sender` (String) The email address used as the sender (From) for outgoing messages. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `use_auth` (Boolean) Whether the SMTP server requires authentication. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `use_sender` (Boolean) Whether to use a custom sender (From) address. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to use SSL/TLS when connecting to the SMTP server. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) The username for SMTP authentication. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.
- `x_password` (String, Sensitive) The password for SMTP authentication. Only applicable when `enabled` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
